name: Casino_Poker_SwapTenSlots

evidence: Recovered body now readable: calls Casino_Poker_ShuffleDeck13/Casino_Poker_ShuffleDeck4, swaps exactly ten 2-byte slots (f_17,f_19,...,f_29) through func_00416638, then uses func_0051B1FC(global rng)%6 as a rotation count - exactly ten slots, as the name says.
